name: GLEIF LEI API
tier_rationale: Not-for-profit foundation operating the Global LEI System, with published terms (A8 trusted): 'tiers: RFB, CVM, BCB, GLEIF and Wikimedia all trusted' (P361 cond 7); P220 provider tier trusted.

reliability.justification: Authoritative Global LEI System data (LEI records and parent/child relationships validated by the issuing organisations); most Brazilian SMEs have no LEI, so a miss is never a risk signal (P220 cond 6).

lei_api.title: GLEIF LEI API v1 (lei-records filters, fuzzycompletions, direct/ultimate parent and children)

terms.quote: Host api.gleif.org, keyless, CC0 (attribution courtesy line), documented 60 req/min: min_interval 1 s and a registry quota.

lei_api.notes: Research C0515 terms 'GLEIF data CC0' / 'CC0 1.0.' One shared GLEIF client for P220 and P361 (P220 cond 1); the registeredAs filter always sends the formatted CNPJ (P220 cond 2); 404 is a declared absence (absent_statuses {404}, P220 cond 7). Used by gleif and cnpj_name_resolver.

notes: Seeded once for batches p2-G10-1 and p2-G10-3 (P220, P361). Quota: the GLEIF API documentation (https://api.gleif.org/docs, checked 2026-11-26) states 'Rate limiting is currently set at 60 requests, per minute, per user, for all users.' and that there is no charge for the use of the LEI data: rate 1/s per egress IP (budget 0.8/s) plus min_interval 1 s (P220 cond 1). ttl 259200 = company registry data (CNPJ class, P326 cond 7). 401/403/429, timeouts, 5xx and error-in-200 bodies are could-not-verify statuses and never cached (P220 cond 7).
